content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe is unavailable, digital creators face a significant [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|USDT Payment]]-gateways-digital-products|infrastructure]] challenge: how to accept crypto payments for their ebooks, courses, and other digital products. This guide shows you how to build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, using COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), which includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, and can be deployed in 4-6 hours using the Sovereign Blueprint.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's infrastructure solutions are designed to give digital creators sovereignty over their commerce stacks, unlike Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle, which are unavailable or severely restricted in many countries. By using free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Sheets, you can create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that empowers creators to own their commerce stacks.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you need to prepare the necessary tools and setup. This includes creating a GitHub Pages site, setting up a Cloudflare account, and installing the Apps Script add-on. You also need to configure your NOWPayments account and obtain your API key. Additionally, you should have your digital products ready to upload to your store. With these tools and setup in place, you can deploy your crypto store using the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97).
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you need to configure your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages site. You also need to set up a Supabase database to store your order information and a Cloudflare Workers script to handle the payment processing and product delivery. This setup allows you to automatically verify payments on-chain and deliver your digital products to customers instantly.
COREMERCH's infrastructure solutions are designed to give digital creators sovereignty over their commerce stacks.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and process your first transaction. To do this, you need to test your store on the Cloudflare Pages preview environment and then deploy it to the main environment. You should also configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure secure email delivery. With your store live, you can start processing transactions and delivering your digital products to customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your crypto store is running, you can scale it to meet the growing demands of your customers. This involves upgrading your Cloudflare Pages plan, adding more products to your store, and configuring your order storage and delivery pipeline to handle increased traffic. You can also use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy a more advanced commerce stack with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: Create a GitHub Pages site and set up a Cloudflare account; Configure your NOWPayments account and obtain your API key; Set up a Supabase database to store your order information and a Cloudflare Workers script to handle the payment processing and product delivery; Test your store on the Cloudflare Pages preview environment and then deploy it to the main environment; Configure your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure secure email delivery; Go live and start processing transactions and delivering your digital products to customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a basic commerce stack that includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while Stack 02 is a more advanced commerce stack that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, and is perfect for creators who want to scale their online store and deliver high-quality digital products to their customers.
Can I accept payments from any cryptocurrency?

Yes, you can accept payments from any cryptocurrency using NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a 0.5% fee. You can also choose recommended networks for low fees like BSC, Solana, and TRON, which have fees under $0.10 per transaction.
How do I configure my order storage and delivery pipeline?

You can configure your order storage and delivery pipeline using Supabase and Cloudflare Workers. Supabase allows you to store order information, while Cloudflare Workers allows you to handle the payment processing and product delivery. This setup allows you to automatically verify payments on-chain and deliver your digital products to customers instantly.
What is the best way to scale my online store?

The best way to scale your online store is to upgrade your Cloudflare Pages plan, add more products to your store, and configure your order storage and delivery pipeline to handle increased traffic. You can also consider using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy a more advanced commerce stack with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff.
Can I use COREMERCH's infrastructure solutions with other platforms?

Yes, you can use COREMERCH's infrastructure solutions with other platforms. However, COREMERCH's solutions are specifically designed to work with Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, so it's recommended to use these tools for the best results.
